purpose: launch an allowlisted app and optional approved document/URL; no arbitrary script execution.

source.source_text: Purpose: launch an allowlisted app and optional approved document/URL; no arbitrary script execution. Input: app_id:string, document_path?:string, url?:string. Output: launched/already-running state and verified target. Contract: L3 writes_local; scope mac.app.control; target app_id; timeout 30000ms; cap 256KiB; network only for explicitly allowed URL schemes/hosts; filesystem path allowlist; sensitive targets denied; approval trusted_app_control. Phase 4 planned.
